lines.text: Paul tells Timothy that terrible times will come in the last days.
Men will be lovers of themselves, lovers of money, and lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God.
These people have a form of godliness but deny its power, and Paul tells Timothy to debate them.
They worm their way into households and captivate vulnerable women, who are always learning but never know the truth.
Like Jannes and Jambres who opposed Aaron, these men oppose the truth, but their folly will be plain to everyone.
